RunnerCapability.description: A host feature the Computer has. Every other v2 behavior is part of protocol 2 itself.

context_window.description: Context length in tokens, from the gateway on the Runtime's API link, the window declared to Claude on its API link, or the Runtime's own catalog; absent when unknown.

link.description: How the Runtime reaches the model: api through a gateway and key configured in the Runtime, subscription through the vendor account it signed in to; absent when the Computer does not report it.

is_default.description: True for the model the Runtime runs when none is selected.

ContextViewSkill.description: One Skill package the receiver fetches from TeamHub with the Agent credential and projects read-only under .agents/skills/<package_name>.

ContextViewManifest.description: Content of one Context View. The Agent Service serves these exact bytes; their SHA-256 is the view_digest every ContextViewRef names.

ContextViewRef.description: Names a Context View by the SHA-256 digest of its content manifest. A receiver that lacks this View fetches the manifest and the files it does not hold from the context_content_url of the current connection's runner.welcome.

SharedTaskScopeId.description: TeamHub identifier used as a single directory segment on every platform.

SharedTaskScope.description: TeamHub-trusted shared Task directory identity. The receiver resolves it under its own configured shared root; no host path crosses the protocol. A meta scope has no task_id; an alter_ego scope requires one.

BrowserConnectionStatus.description: The browser that browser tools of this owner's Agents drive on this Computer. It never contains the extension token.

BrowserProfile.description: A Chrome profile directory name inside the user's Chrome data directory.

extension_token.description: Playwright Extension token, only with configure. The daemon stores it privately and never returns it.

ComputerPermissionStatus.description: The macOS privacy permissions of this Computer. Other platforms report no subjects.

subject.description: Required for every action except status.

capacity.description: Optional Computer-wide active Operation limit. Omission means unlimited.

context_content_url.description: Base URL the Computer fetches Context View manifests (views/<view_digest>) and files (files/<sha256>) from while this connection is current.

AgentCliCredentialReport.description: The CLI credential the Daemon stores for the Agent, without its token, and the Runtime Assignment it was installed for.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the token itself, the hash TeamHub records for it.
SHA-256 of the stored token itself.

permission_review.description: The Daemon sends Runtime permission prompts as human_interaction.requested with kind permission_review; Agent Service answers each with an operation.input runtime_response.

SessionCompact.description: Compacts the native session of the process parked for this Context with the Runtime's own compaction. It never starts a process; without a parked process the answer is no_process.

ModelInvoke.description: Runs one model call on the Computer's signed-in Codex or Claude CLI in a fresh temporary directory, outside the Operation ledger and without a Context. Only structured carries output_schema, which it requires; only workspace carries workspace_files, the input files of the temporary directory, and gets its tree back. A workspace file may not be AGENTS.md, AGENTS.override.md or CLAUDE.md at the root or lie under a .codex or .claude directory. Codex cannot read files in workspace mode, so the Daemon also inlines the workspace files into the prompt and Codex writes only through apply_patch. The Daemon answers failed for a request that breaks these rules, and for a reply whose encoded model.invoked would exceed the frame limit.

max_output_chars.description: Caps the characters the model may stream in its reply. A Daemon interrupts a session call that streams more and answers output_limited with what it streamed. Calls that run on their own are bounded by timeout_ms only.

session_key.description: Names the session a structured call belongs to. A Daemon answers the Codex calls of one session in one resident thread whose base instructions are the call's instructions, so only the input is new to the provider; while that thread answers another call, and for Claude, the call runs on its own. Either way the result is the same.

ModelInvoked.description: Advisory outcome of one model.invoke. An outcome nobody waits for is ignored.

text.description: The reply of a completed call. For a session call that timed_out, was output_limited or canceled, what the model had streamed so far, when anything.

oneOf.description: One completed model request, reported once per native response. started_at is when the Runtime had the request's inputs; first_item_at is the first observable output at the stated granularity and is not a time to first token.

agent.description: Present for a sub-agent's request; absent for the Run's own agent.

OperationInputClosed.description: Durable command receipt for an input targeting a terminal Operation. Does not belong to or advance the immutable Operation event sequence.
